title: HDSR mowing-material digestion planning scenario for RWZI Nieuwegein
license: No explicit reuse license identified in the report.
geography: HDSR service region, Netherlands; proposed digestion at RWZI Nieuwegein

units_and_basis.annual_feed_input: t/year of mowing material; wet/dry basis unspecified; report does not separate verge grass from ditch cuttings
units_and_basis.projected_annual_biogas_output: m3 biogas/year; gas reference temperature and pressure and methane fraction unspecified

data_handling: Only the two linked quantities stated in the annual report are transcribed. The proposal's feed and gas figures are not converted into a specific yield or methane output.
applicability: Historical Dutch regional project-scenario comparator across feedstock availability and anaerobic digestion; not GreenHub process performance.
limitations: The 30,000 t/year input is mixed verge and ditch mowing material with no source split, wet/dry basis, weighbridge evidence, feed characterization, or contracted fraction.
The 3.4 million m3/year gas quantity is forecast output, not measured production; reference conditions, methane fraction, uptime, process boundary, and uncertainty are absent.
The annual report says procurement prevented continuation in 2021 and that a restart was planned for 2022; this report does not verify later implementation or performance.
Keep the two values paired as a project projection; do not use them as a GreenHub default, methane yield, or saleable biomethane output.
